senses.gloss: m.(b. h. only in pl.; סָמַר)a pointed object, nail, pin.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:10">Sabb. VI, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:11">67ᵃ</cite>) <he>מ׳ מן הצלוב</he> (Y. ed. <he>מ׳ הצלוב</he>) a nail from the gallows of an impaled convict (used as an amulet).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:4">Kel. XII, 4</cite> <he>מ׳ הגרע</he> the blood-letter’s pin (v. infra); <he>מ׳ של אבן השעות</he> the style of the sun-dial; <he>מ׳ הגרדי</he> the weaver’s pin. Ib. 5 <he>מ׳ שהתקינו וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 14</cite> <he>מ׳ שעקמו וכ׳</he> an iron pin which was bent in order to be used as a key. Kel. l. c. <he>מ׳ של שלחני</he> the banker’s pin for fastening the shutters, v. <cite ref="V00995"><he>תְּרִיס</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:4">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>מ׳ שיש לו שושנה</he> a nail which has a big knob.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 3</cite> <he>מקל שעשה בראשו מ׳ להיות תופס בו וכ׳</he> a staff to the end of which a pin was attached for the sake of taking hold of the threshing floor (of making it stationary); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:10">ib. V, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:2">B. Bath. VII, 2</cite> <he>חוט המ׳ של וכ׳</he> the builder’s cord to which a pin is attached (i.e. plumb-line).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:11">B. Mets. II, 11</cite> <he>מ׳ הגרוע</he> the scraper’s pin (fastened to the smith’s block); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַסְמְרִים</he>, <he>מַסְמְרִין</he>, <he>מַסְמְרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 7b:12">B. Bath. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>קבע בה מ׳</he> drive nails into it, i.e. remember it well.

Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 11 גולת חנוני שכולה מ׳ a store-keeper’s bowl (?) studded all over with nails. Tanḥ. B’haăl. 15 (ref. to Koh. XII, 11) כתיב כמשמרות ואנו קורין מ׳ וכ׳ it is written k’mishm’roth (like guards) and we read k’masm’roth (like nails) to teach thee, if thou drivest them like a nail into thy heart, they will guard thee; Num. R. s. 4.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:4">Esth. R. to VI, 10</cite> <he>אני</he> … <he>חבלים ומ׳</he> I prepared for thee ropes and nails (for impaling); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (pl.) cloves. Num. R. l. c. ערבין … כמ׳ נטועים as sweet to their hearers as cloves.
a peg-shaped attachment to a loaf, knob.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:3">T’bul Yom I, 3</cite> <he>מ׳ שאחר הככר</he> the knob on the back of the loaf (supposed to serve as trade-mark).

senses.gloss: a wart or corn (cmp. Lat. clavus).—Pl. מַסְמְרוֹת. Sifra Thazr. Neg., Par. 1, ch. II המ׳; Tosef. Neg. II, 12 המַסְמֶרֶת (sing.).
